code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed leading chiral leptonic-kaon benchmark; no source is configured.

publication.title: Radiative semileptonic kaon decays
publication.authors: J. Bijnens, G. Ecker and J. Gasser
publication.equations: 4.8-4.22; equal-mass loops from Appendix A.9-A.11; real-photon controls from 3.14-3.17

scope: A standalone historical O(p4) chiral rate and event benchmark for K+ to lepton+ neutrino A-prime, retaining both external-leg IB terms, complex pion/kaon loops, virtual-only form factors and all three vector polarizations. K- events use an explicit CP reflection and charge exchange of the complete chain, assuming real Vus and CP-conserving strong/electromagnetic currents; absorptive strong phases are retained.

event_sampler.production: Unit-weight analytic-cell rejection against the full IB+SD spin density. The cell bounds follow positive spin-projector operator norms, explicit positive propagator minima and current Frobenius norms; no empirical scan defines them.
event_sampler.dimuon: Full conditional three-state density: Tr(rho)-beta_mu^2*n^T*Re(rho)*n. Tr(rho) is a proven rejection bound, with mean efficiency at least 2/3.
event_sampler.normalization: The shape proposal uses epsilon=0.001 internally, which cancels in normalized sampling. The caller applies the physical production rate and dimuon branching exactly once.
event_sampler.mass_authority: Daughter construction uses the incoming parent four-vector's invariant mass and records the separate physical model mass. Extra inherited mass-squared precision is caller-qualified; no parent four-vector is rescaled.

input_uncertainties.meaning: The primary Table 1 gives these historical marginal errors at M_rho. Varying the LECs separately or over a rectangular box is a model diagnostic, not a measured confidence interval or a bound on all higher chiral orders.

explicit_conventions.decay_constant_normalization: Fpi=93.2 MeV, FK=113.6 MeV as Appendix A.6. Do not substitute the sqrt(2)*F convention without changing the weak-current normalization.
explicit_conventions.em_form_factor: F_K^V(q2)=1+H_pi_pi(q2)+2 H_K_K(q2), including the complex pion cut, with L9 running at the same subtraction scale as the loops.
explicit_conventions.spectral_conversion: Continuum pair conversion only for distinguishable charged leptons, before QED corrections. Identical positive leptons require exchange and a symmetry factor.

independent_controls.real_photon_density: Primary Eqs3.14-3.17, for IB, SD and interference separately.

old_nonidentical_virtual_prediction.channel: K+ to mu+ nu e+ e-

unqualified_terms: The historical LEC/normalization card is not a current precision fit. Higher chiral orders and measured form-factor alternatives are separate model uncertainties.
The event sampler retains polarization and lepton-vector correlations, but native whole-collision attachment, charged-lepton recoil admission and transport remain separate qualification gates.
Parent flight, charged bending, material interactions, secondary sources and detector acceptance are not supplied.
The measured identical-muon NA62 branching fraction is not a normalization for the distinguishable single-current continuum conversion.
